body:
The NIST/SEMATECH e-Handbook of Statistical Methods page "2.5.6. Uncertainty budgets and sensitivity coefficients" says: "Uncertainty budgets and sensitivity coefficients Case study showing uncertainty budget Uncertainty components are listed in a table along with their corresponding sensitivity coefficients, standard deviations and degrees of freedom. A table of typical entries illustrates the concept. Typical budget of type A and type B uncertainty components Type A components Sensitivity coefficient Standard deviation Degrees freedom 1. Time (repeatability) \(a_1\) --> \(s_1\) --> \(
u_1\) v1 --> 2. Time (reproducibility) \(a_2\) --> \(s_2\) --> \(
u_2\) v2 --> 3. Time (long-term) \(a_3\) --> \(s_3\) --> \(
u_3\) v3 --> Type B components 4. Reference standard (nominal test / nominal ref) \(s_4\) --> \(
u_4\) v4 --> Sensitivity coefficients show how components are related to result The sensitivity coefficient shows the relationship of the individual uncertainty component…" This card records that page. It does not add a data set the page did not print.
